Before you ask

The questions we get every week.

How do you choose vendors?

By hand, for you. There's no standing list we hand to everyone. After we've talked and I understand the room you want, I go to the people in our network who fit that specific day: the budget, the vibe, the venue, the way you like to be talked to. Every event is different, so every list is different.

How far out should we book?

Nine to fourteen months is the comfortable window for full planning, though we've come in much later and made it work. Coordination can start as late as three months out. We take a limited number of full productions each season, so earlier is better for both of us.

Do you travel?

Yes. We're based in Philadelphia and work regularly in New York, the Hudson Valley, and the Eastern Shore. Travel beyond that region is billed at cost and quoted up front.

What if we land between two services?

That happens more often than not. The four services are shapes, not boxes. If you want The Polished Finish plus design, or The Styled Story plus extra staff, we build it and price it plainly.

Do you work on things other than weddings?

Yes. Milestone celebrations, private dinners, corporate events, galas, and brand activations. The production spine is the same; the brief is different.

Meet Kumbah

The people behind
the name.

Founder & head producer

I'm Kumbah.

I've spent more than a decade in events, most of it running other people's floors. KS&Co. Events is the company I always wanted to work for: one that treats logistics as craft, tells clients the truth about everything from budget to whether that centerpiece is actually a good idea, and never makes anyone feel like they're standing in the wrong room.

I'm not a vendor you have to manage. I'm the person in it with you. You'll have my number, my honest read, and a partner who cares what this day costs you in stress as much as in dollars.

Kumbah Sarnor
~

You are not hiring one person. You are hiring the network she spent a decade building.

Coordinators, designers, and producers I've worked beside for years, brought onto your event because they fit it. Everyone who walks your floor in a KS&Co. headset has done this before, with me, and knows how I run a room.

How I work

No standing vendor list. Ever.

A lot of planners hand every client the same six names. It's efficient, and this industry's kickback culture rewards it. I don't do it.

Every couple and every room is different, so the shortlist gets built after we talk, not before. Sometimes that means a vendor below my usual price band. Sometimes it means telling you the photographer you love won't work in that venue's light. Either way, you get the real answer.

Practical things

The details you'd ask about anyway.

Where are you based?

Philadelphia, with regular productions in New York, the Hudson Valley, and the Eastern Shore. We travel for full productions by request, billed at cost.

How many events do you take a year?

A limited number of full-service productions each season, deliberately. Mini services and staffing sit outside that count. When a date is genuinely full, we say so and point you to someone good.

Who will actually be at my event?

Me, plus the coordinators we've assigned to your day. You'll meet the lead before the event, and everyone on the floor will have been briefed from the same run-of-show. No unfamiliar faces on the day.

What kinds of events do you take?

Weddings and milestone celebrations make up most of it. We also produce private dinners, corporate events, galas, and brand activations, which use the same production spine with a different brief.

A New Chapter for KS&Co.

What a summer it has been in Philadelphia. Between the World Cup, the PGA Championship, the MLB All Star Game, and our city's 250th anniversary celebrations, Philadelphia had the world watching. And in the middle of it all, there were still ceremonies, receptions, and quiet moments of love happening all across the city. We felt lucky to be part of so many of those days. If you got married this summer, thank you for trusting us with something so important.

Now that wedding season is settling into its next stretch, we wanted to share a little news of our own.

KS&Co. is expanding our network.

We are welcoming more wonderful venues, photographers, florists, caterers, entertainers, producers and more into our circle. Every single one is chosen with the same care we bring to everything we do because we believe your event team should feel like an extension of you.

What Couples Really Want

After years of doing this, we have noticed that couples tend to want the same handful of things, even if they never say it outright.

They want to feel confident in the people working behind the scenes. They want fewer overwhelming decisions and more options that already feel right. They want a wedding that feels like them, not something pulled off a template. And they want someone they can call when plans shift last minute, because plans always shift last minute.

That is exactly why we are growing. A stronger network means more wonderful choices for you, less guesswork, and a team of vendors who already know how to work beautifully together.

We Are Heading Into the Height of Wedding Season

This is the part of the year we look forward to all along. Fall color, crisp evenings, twinkling lights, there is something about a Philadelphia wedding this time of year that just feels right. We only have a couple of dates left on our calendar, so if you have been sitting on the fence about locking one in, consider this your gentle nudge.

Even if your date is already set and your big decisions are behind you, it is often the small finishing touches that make a wedding feel complete. Things like a thoughtful welcome sign, a well timed send off, or a little extra polish on the tablescape can go a long way. This is exactly where our mini services come in. They are small enough to fit into almost any plan, and they are designed to help with those last details without adding stress to your final weeks. Feel free to ask us about them, even just for ideas. We are always happy to share what has worked beautifully for other couples, no strings attached.

We Would Love to Hear From You

As we grow, we want to build this network around what real couples actually need. What has been the hardest part of planning so far? Is there one type of vendor that feels harder to figure out than the rest? Leave a comment, send us a message, or tag us in your planning posts. Your answers are genuinely helping shape who joins KS&Co. next.

Planning a special event? Get in touch and let us help you build your dream team.

More Than a Name: The Meaning Behind KS&Co. Events

One vision. A collective spirit. Something bigger than ourselves.

Every business has a story. Sometimes, it begins with a dream. Sometimes, it begins with a leap of faith. And sometimes, it begins with a name that means more than meets the eye.

For me, that name is KS&Co. Events.

The KS represents me, Kumbah Sarnor, the founder and lead producer behind the vision. The Co. represents everything beyond me: the people, partnerships, creativity, and collective effort that make this work possible.

When I chose the name, I knew I wanted to build something that was personal to me but never limited to me.

After 20 years in hospitality, including a decade dedicated to weddings and events, I had spent years producing experiences, managing event operations, navigating the intricacies of catering and sales, and bringing other people's visions to life. Eventually, I knew it was time to take a leap of my own and build the company I had always envisioned.

That company became KS&Co. Events.

The Power of the Collective

As much as this business reflects my vision, creativity, and approach to producing events, I know firsthand that no great event happens because of one person alone.

It takes trusted vendor partners who understand the vision. It takes talented event professionals who know how to execute with precision. It takes creative collaborators who bring fresh ideas to the table and a team that understands that every detail matters.

It takes people who care about the work as much as you do.

That is what the Co. represents.

It is a reflection of the community I value and the network I continue to build. It represents the belief that collaboration makes us stronger, that great partnerships create better experiences, and that the right people can take an idea from a beautiful concept to something extraordinary.

Because behind every seamless experience is a team working together to make it happen.

A Vision That Extends Beyond Me

I didn't want to build a business that depended solely on my name or my presence in every room. I wanted to build a company with room to grow, room for other talented people to contribute, and room for a vision that could extend far beyond its founder.

The Co. is also a declaration of that intention.

It speaks to the company I am building today and the company I envision for tomorrow. A collective of trusted professionals. A growing network of creative minds and skilled event specialists. A business where clients can feel confident knowing their experience is supported by more than one person's expertise.

My role is to lead the vision, bring the right people together, and create the structure that allows every moving piece to work in harmony.

The goal has never been to do it all alone. The goal is to build something meaningful, together.

More Than Events

At KS&Co. Events, we believe the best experiences are both thoughtfully designed and intentionally executed. We believe creativity needs structure, beautiful details deserve thoughtful consideration, and exceptional production is just as important as the vision itself.

Our work is rooted in collaboration, thoughtful design, and a commitment to bringing each client's vision to life in a way that feels personal to them.

And while every event has its own story, the philosophy behind our work remains the same: bring the right people together, give every detail a purpose, and create an experience that feels effortless to the people enjoying it.

Because that is what we want our clients to remember. Not the moving pieces, the timelines, or the coordination happening behind the scenes, but how it all came together.

One Name. A Whole Lot of Co.

KS&Co. Events will always carry my name, my story, and my vision. But its future belongs to something bigger: the relationships we build, the people we bring together, and the experiences we create collectively.

There may be one name behind the vision, but there is an entire team behind the execution.

And that is the heart of KS&Co. Events.

A personal vision with a collective spirit, built to create something bigger, together.

Welcome to KS&Co. Events.

Privacy

A simple policy for your information.

This page explains what KS&Co. Events collects through this website and how we use it.

Effective October 25, 2026

Information we collect

When you submit the inquiry form or contact us directly, we may receive your name, email address, phone number, event details, budget range, and anything else you choose to share. Our website host may also process basic technical information, such as your IP address, browser type, and request logs, to deliver and protect the site.

How we use it

We use the information you provide to respond to your inquiry, discuss or deliver event planning services, keep appropriate business records, and protect the website from spam or misuse. We do not sell or rent your personal information.

Service providers

We use trusted providers to operate this website and respond to inquiries. These currently include Netlify for website hosting, Web3Forms for form delivery, and our email provider. They may process information only as needed to provide those services and under their own privacy and security terms.

Cookies and analytics

We do not currently use advertising cookies or third-party advertising trackers. Our hosting and form providers may use essential technologies and technical logs to operate, secure, and monitor their services. If we add optional analytics or marketing tools later, we will update this policy and provide any notice or choice required by law.

How long we keep information

We keep inquiry and client information only as long as reasonably necessary to respond, provide services, meet legal or accounting obligations, resolve disputes, and protect our business. Our service providers may have their own retention schedules.

Your choices

You may ask us to access, correct, or delete personal information you have shared with us, subject to any legal or recordkeeping obligations. You can also choose to contact us by email instead of using the website form.

Children's privacy

This website and our services are not directed to children under 13, and we do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13 through this website.

Links and updates

This site may link to other websites whose privacy practices we do not control. We may update this policy when our website, services, or legal obligations change. The effective date above will show when the latest version took effect.

Contact us

For a privacy question or request, email hello@ksandcoevents.com.
